Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: This study is a method development and benchmarking project using synthetic recombinant protein standards and a biological cell line (HEK293T) to evaluate a new search engine (Scout). It is not a differential proteomics study comparing treated vs control biological states, hence the 'un-classified' label for biological variables.

base_candidates_ranked.reason: Data-dependent acquisition (DDA) was used on an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos; however, the primary goal is identification of cross-links rather than relative quantification.

modifier_candidates_ranked.reason: The experiment specifically uses MS-cleavable cross-linkers (DSSO and Azide-A-DSBSO) and requires specialized search engines (Scout, XlinkX, etc.) to identify cross-linked peptides.

Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: This is a specialized XL-MS experiment. Standard bottom-up pipelines will fail to identify the cross-linked peptides because they require specific mass shifts and fragmentation patterns associated with cleavable cross-linkers (DSSO/DSBSO). The analysis is focused on identification (CSM, ResPair, PPI) rather than differential abundance.
